title: Predator Of Love
paragraphs: The dragon sitting there was eating something. Its color was red, and its form was that of a complete Western dragon. Compared to the rival’s parent, it looked rounder in places, but it was also about twice as large… Such a dragon was sitting on the throne, waiting.
“Huh? What do you mean by welcome…?”
“Gaelion was waiting for Naofumi and the others to come, na~no!”
“Um, Motoyasu-san? That dragon… is referring to itself as Gaelion, right? It seems to be speaking…”
“That’s not it.”
“But it’s talking as if it knows us?”
“No. This is not the one we need to recruit. This is one of my enemies, a traitor who pretends to be an ally and causes all kinds of trouble.”
Why is it here? Cold sweat wouldn’t stop. This must be an illusion.
“Um… I heard you’re Motoyasu’s enemy. Is that true?”
Father took a step forward, but he shouldn’t. I stepped in front of him, grabbing his hand protectively.
“Motoyasu?”
“Don’t listen to a word it says.”
“Oh my~?”
“Hmph… You’ve already got the orca woman, na~no? Gaelion might’ve taken too long, but I won’t give up, na~no.”
The rival (probably) was looking at big sister when it spoke. That’s right! Big sister was here with us.
“Why are you here?”
“Na~no na~no na~no… The Spear Hero really is too simple, na~no.”
“Agreed.”
“I can’t deny that.”
Ren and Itsuki nodded in agreement.
Whose side are you two on? Then, the rival (probably) covered its mouth with its hand and started giggling.
“Do you not understand why Gaelion spoke in front of the Spear Hero, na~no? If we looped again, Gaelion told me so we could meet under the best circumstances, na~no.”
“What did you say!?”

“That’s right. Naofumi doesn’t see children who grew up close to him as romantic interests, na~no. You can figure that out just by analyzing him. So if we were to loop again, Gaelion needed to avoid meeting him until after becoming an adult, na~no.”
“Uh, Motoyasu? Can I ask what the heck you’re talking about?”
Father asked me, but this was something I couldn’t explain. I was sweating bullets.
This can’t be… Even though I had prevented the rival from meeting Father, the rival had already anticipated that plan?
“Next question! Where did your parent and assistant go?”
“Geh, wait a minute, na~no. Gaelion needs some grooming since you came while I was eating, na~no.”
Saying that, the rival started wiping its face with its hand repeatedly.
What grooming? A barbaric dragon like you pretending to be refined is a hundred years too early.
“Judging from that line and your response…”
“You… ate—”
Ren and Itsuki froze in shock.
Did it… take out its parent and assistant as well!? The rival waved its hand from side to side.
“No, na~no. Big sister and Dad just left peacefully after Gaelion asked them to, and now they’re in the territory I seized deep in the mountains, na~no.”
It puffed up its cheeks and acted all offended, but there’s no way I could believe that.
“Right now, they’re probably spending their time peacefully, na~no.”
No, its parent and assistant were definitely in its stomach.
“More importantly, shouldn’t you be asking Gaelion how I rose to power, na~no?”
“Rose to power?”
“Hmph! I don’t want to hear it!”
“Even though you say that, Gaelion will tell you everything that happened, na~no. Otherwise, I can’t make the Spear Hero despair, na~no.”
“I don’t want to hear it!”
I pointed my spear at the rival. Father and the others looked at me with puzzled expressions.
Why doesn’t anyone recognize it as an enemy?
This is strange!
“Motoyasu?”
“First, let me tell you how Gaelion rose to power in this loop, na~no. It all started when the Spear Hero casually threw away the egg that Gaelion was residing in, na~no.”
“Ah… come to think of it, the merchant where the Spear Hero-sama bought Keel-kun and the others also sold an egg that wasn’t a Filolial.”
Evidence from big sister’s friend at this point!?
This was like a sniper shot from behind! Father and the others were looking at me with narrowed eyes.
No! This was all for Father’s sake! If the rival had hatched and grown up back then, Father would’ve lost his purity!
“And that egg… is the one you threw away in the chaos, isn’t it?”
At Itsuki’s question, the rival nodded.
“Throwing it away was all part of the plan, so I’ll forgive you for that, na~no.”
“That was just a ploy to gain favor with Father! I won’t let that happen!”
“Motoyasu, calm down for now. Let’s listen first.”
Father firmly grabbed my shoulder. I could probably shake him off if I tried, but I could never go against Father.

“Na~no. Gaelion, who was swept away by the stream, floated along until I hatched, and then I grew up by feeding on whatever I could find, na~no. The opportunity came quickly, and I experienced a rapid growth spurt. Do you know why, na~no?”
The rival looked at me with a provocative gaze. As if I could ever understand what you were thinking. And I don’t even want to know.
“Of course I don’t know! Such nonsense.”
“It’s not nonsense, na~no. Because the one who boosted Gaelion’s level so quickly… was you, Spear Hero.”
“What… did you say!?”
The rival chuckled menacingly.
“Of course, you didn’t realize it, na~no. Spear Hero… when you were raising those Filolials, you didn’t notice that your own experience points were being reduced, na~no.”
“What does that mean!?”
Grrr… This sounds like something incredibly ominous!

“Spear Hero doesn’t get it, na~no? Do you think Gaelion just hitched a ride on the loop through the spear, na~no? Didn’t you forget that you yourself talked about how Dad in the first world did something similar through Filolials and Naofumi, na~no?”

Hah!? Now that I think about it, I did tell Father and the others about what happened in the first world. The reason the rival’s parent was there, and the painful events that happened to Filo-tan, which I heard through rumors. It’s a problem that must absolutely be avoided. If I recall correctly… the rival’s parent parasitized Father’s shield and Filo-tan’s body to survive and revive. I heard that at that time, it drained a large amount of experience from Filo-tan.
Could it be… that something similar happened this time? …Come to think of it, didn’t Father also mention that some of his experience was leaking out and being given to someone?

“That’s right, na~no. Gaelion took a portion of the experience points the Spear Hero earned and grew stronger very quickly, na~no. After that, it was easy, na~no. Gaelion went around challenging the Dragon Emperors near Melromarc and collected the Dragon Emperor’s fragments one after another, na~no!”
Impossible!
The experience I earned was flowing to the rival!?

“Well, there was a dangerous period for a while, but by borrowing a little of the power from the curse within the Spear Hero’s spear… by becoming the Last Dragon, I was able to fight without any problems, na~no.”
The rival clicked its tongue mockingly.
So annoying!

“Just as the Spear Hero calls himself the Love Hunter, Gaelion is a Predator of Love! That’s why Gaelion’s body was a perfect match for the Spear Hero’s cursed spear, na~no. I suppressed it before being completely consumed and returned, but I gained plenty from it, na~no. The Spear Hero’s love is so simple… but… never mind, na~no!”
Guh… So it used the power of the Last Envy Spear, which Filo-tan had forbidden me from using!? Father fought the Wrath Dragon, the incarnation of fury that was taken by the rival’s parent.
In my case, would it be called the Last Dragon…?
“Um, if I remember correctly, Dragon Emperors fight each other to take the fragments and become stronger each time they gather them, right?”
“Na~no!”
“If I deduce from what I heard secondhand from Motoyasu… that thing is a monster with power comparable to Motoyasu!”
“Heh. When it comes to strength, Gaelion won’t lose to Naofumi and the others, na~no.”
“A monster beyond imagination has appeared!”
“Can we even win against it?”
“Uh… judging by the vibe, doesn’t it feel like fighting might not be the goal here?”
“A fight is unavoidable!”
That’s right! I pointed my spear at the rival.
